notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of Outbreak: Shades of Horror can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

Cypress Reel


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

Story mode


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

Invasion mode


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

Raid mode


This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of Outbreak: Shades of Horror, Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

Mini-games


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when Outbreak: Shades of Horror begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

notes.title: Visual Novel 'What Lydia Knows' Launches FRIDAY May 3rd!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/3a0206c53c19290a6b1538592fe9d1c561111128.png

Hello Survivors!

Get ready for a double-dose of adventure this Friday, May 3rd, when Outbreak The FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows launches on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Epic Games Store!

Enjoy a 25% off launch discount here on Steam!

This two game pack includes the following:

FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows

In our first file of “The FEDORA Files” three part limited series: What Lydia Knows, play as intrepid detective Lydia Daniels as she tries to discover the mystery behind her partner's disappearance. Search for clues, probe allies and enemies, and solve the mystery of the Jackson Street Sewers in this installment that acts a prequel to Outbreak: Shades of Horror.

Features:

Narrative rich visual novel with a deep and engrossing storyline.
Multiple paths and endings to unlock where your choices matter.
Meet, befriend, or alienate a wide cast of characters where your relationships matter.
Solve devious puzzles and navigate crazy minigames as you hunt for the truth.


Outbreak RPG

In the aftermath of the Outbreak, play a group of survivors out to rescue their compatriots in Outbreak RPG! A Semi procedurally generated rogue-like RPG, every boot up is a new adventure. Rescued survivors will bring new skills and challenges with them. Can you survive the Outbreak?!

Features:

Semi procedurally generated rogue-like RPG
Lead your party of four survivors through the apocalypse in turn-based combat
Search for supplies to keep yourself armed and healthy
Rescue a wide group of survivors, each of which joins your team with unique upgrades and abilities
Challenging escalating enemy encounters as the city becomes further overrun with the undead
Hilarious and ridiculous dialogue in this non-canon adventure

notes.title: Railbreak Update 5 is now available. Massive performance and graphics improvemen
notes.content:
Railbreak Update 5 has been released with the following fixes on Steam.


 Massive performance improvements for all hardware to remove remaining stutter, reduce overhead of having many enemies on screen, remove strange slowdown when the Kunoichi is on screen, and especially remove stutter during explosions or chaotic scenes.
 DLSS 3.5 w/ Frame Generation is fully supported for compatible cards.
 Screen percentage setting now behaves correctly on all hardware.
 Player hair for all characters both looks better and has better performance.
 Bounding boxes remaining after some enemy types have died have been fixed.
 Minor balancing and other fixes across the game.
 The dinosaurs are taking a break but Korrine can still see the future. Can you find them all?

notes.title: Railbreak Content Update One - Time Korrisis - Available Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Qr1tBwmlCBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Railbreak Content Update One (Patch 4) is LIVE NOW and features the following:
- Korrine, the GlitchGoddess, is now available when selecting a character outside of Story Mode.
- She uses special projectile attacks which are different than other characters.
- Korrine's Plasma Cannon (Primary) consumes huge amounts of rifle rounds, but deals extreme damage over a large radius.
- Her sidearm randomly alternates between elemental attacks and will randomly dismember different parts of enemies.
The Katana has the ability to trigger Korrine's Blessing, a super glitch that boosts scoring and damage, but also costs a terrible price as it'll force the player to endure a significant debuff.
- As the Glitch Goddess, Korrine can also see into the future, so you may notice.... differences.... compared to other characters as you play the game. We assure you these changes are only visual, they probably can't hurt you, and only Korrine can see them.
- The Time Korrisis Scoring Mode has been added to the game. Time Korrisis is a new way to play all of the content in Railbreak by turning the game into a Time Attack arcade game.
- In Time Korrisis Mode, you will earn time by damaging and killing enemies, picking up weapons, and more. Headshots and limb shots award extra time.
- If your timer runs out, you'll be instantly killed and will need to spend a life to continue.
This mode tracks your score separately across the game. More time remaining at the end of a level will yield a better rank. Good luck!
- The character screen now clearly explains elemental damage and other traits.
- Significant bug fixes, balancing changes, and graphics improvements across the game.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

Patch 3
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

Patch 2
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

notes.title: Railbreak is available NOW! Launch stream NOW with giveaways!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

https://youtu.be/y-WS-KRfjDM

Today's the day!  Railbreak is now available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store!  Pick it up for $19.99 USD worldwide (international pricing may vary).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587170/Railbreak/

While Cypress Ridge is enduring a zombie apocalypse in Outbreak: Shades of Horror, Lydia and Hank hit the arcade for some stress relief!  Railbreak is packed with features and content that will keep you playing! It's a beefy on-rails arcade shooter for the modern age, and it's built in Unreal Engine 5!

Players can look forward to:

A fully voiced, cheese-tastic Story!
Score Attack for grinding those high scores!
The endless Onslaught mode that'll test your skills!
'Glitch' modifiers that keep the gameplay fast and feisty!
Eight total unlockable characters, each with their own loadouts and stats!
Seven radical bosses that are out for blood!
A special scenario that celebrates our supporters -- Shoutout Shootout!
Glitch Gauntlet, A rogue-like version of the campaign with randomized 'Glitches' and enemies!
The mother of all challenges in Boss Rush!
Full game, optional co-op support so you can spread the lead with a friend!
Optional support for Sinden Lightguns on PC platforms!
Local score tracking, a comprehensive How to Play manual, and tons of settings and options!


Please note: If you are playing on Xbox Series X|S, there is a 'day one' update that is not yet live. This will be available as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding, and sorry for the inconvenience!

We've also prepared a series of guides for those of you who are purchasing the Steam version of the game in order to best enjoy it in a variety of configurations:

Railbreak Sinden Lightgun Guide - Setup instructions for using a Sinden Lightgun with Railbreak!

Recommended Steam Deck Settings - How to best configure Railbreak for use on Steam Deck!

Controls and Remote Play Together Guide - See default controls and other tips for multiplayer!

If you aren't already a part of our Discord community, join today and share your best scores with us!  We're holding a launch contest through January 5th at 11:59pm ET with a special prize, so come and compete with the best for your chance to win!

Meanwhile, tonight, December 22nd, at 7PM ET (that's right now!), we're having a special launch stream on our Twitch channel!  For the first time, we'll also be streaming live to Railbreak's Steam store page!  Join us for Railbreak gameplay featuring the Sinden Lightgun, retro on-rail shooter game goodness, and giveaways

Our games are also on sale as part of Steam's Winter Sale, and that includes the Outbreak Complete Collection, which also includes Railbreak! Save on a ton of great Dead Drop Studios games today with this special bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20872/Outbreak_Complete_Collection

With that, we're entering a Holiday break period.  On behalf of everyone at Dead Drop Studios, we would like to wish you and your families a very Merry Christmas, an incredibly Happy Holiday, and a fantastic New Year!

See you in 2024, Survivors!
